ORG.ALIGNERTRACKER.APP

Aligner Tracker

Private aligner wear tracking, reminders and backups

Start recording aligner wear immediately with IN or OUT. Add prescribed hours and tray details when ready; unknown goals and dates are never invented. Track schedules and history on your phone. Includes reminders, a home-screen widget, reports, private progress photos and encrypted portable backups. No account, ads, analytics or Internet permission.

Private development build for owner testing. Physical reminder, battery and full device acceptance remain pending. Phone features work without Google Play services. Optional watch communication needs a compatible Wear service; the watch APK is not included.

Get future updates through your F-Droid client.
